plans.name: Answering Service
plans.integration_scope: No included calendar/CRM integration, booking or screened transfers.

plans.name: Receptionist
plans.integration_scope: Routine receptionist duties and the supporting automation are included in the agreed Level 2 scope, without an additional AhernAI automation or integration-build charge. Confirm software compatibility, access, allowed actions and failure handling during setup; an unverified connection is not an automatic surcharge. Includes qualification, screened transfers, order-taking, appointment changes and agreed customer-record updates. Calendar and CRM work can belong to the same agreed scope.

plans.name: Manager
plans.integration_scope: Receptionist plus handling difficult callers, approved employee coordination, policy guidance and escalation. Financial, employment and policy-exception decisions remain human. Introduce Level 3 only when the caller asks about it, requests all three levels, or raises employee coordination, supervisory duties or difficult/disgruntled callers. Routine order-taking, scheduling, CRM work or the number of connected tools does not trigger a Manager upsell.

terms: One subscription covers one agent, one location and one language; extra agents have separate setup, monthly fees and minute allowances.

Agreed routine receptionist automation is included in Level 2 and Level 3. Separate projects outside the agreed duties, texting usage and additional transfer usage charges are disclosed separately; do not assume an integration surcharge. Final scope and pricing are confirmed before launch.
Named software compatibility is verified during setup. Included duties do not mean universal application support or unlimited development.
Do not invent unlimited usage, discounts, trials, pooling, rollover, contract or cancellation terms. Use the shared pricing text for full terms.
